method: Summon • Demon Parade • Wanted Quests • Dispatch

skills.name: Calabash Spray (鬼葫芦/鬼瓢箪)
skills.description: Shuten Douji sprays a single target enemy with noxious vapors from his calabash, dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK. Also inflicts 1 follow-up attack for each layer of Madness he has. Does not trigger when launching a counter-attack. ;Madness (狂気) :'''Buff, Status''': Increases the number of follow-up attacks Calabash Spray inflicts. :''(1-4 flaming calabash will circle around him, 1 calabash represents 1 layer.)''

skills.name: Madness (狂气/狂気)
skills.description:
At the end of a turn, Shuten Doji has a 50% chance of gaining 1 layer of Madness. When he is attacked, he has a 25% chance of gaining 1 layer. 
Madness has a max of 4 layers. 
;Madness (狂気)
:'''Buff, Status''': Increases the number of follow-up attacks Calabash Spray inflicts.
:''(1-4 flaming calabash will circle around him, 1 calabash represents 1 layer.)''

skills.name: Healing Rage (狂啸/狂い吠え)
skills.description: Shuten Doji emits a burst of energy, restoring his HP by 30% of his max HP and increases his move bar by 50%. He then goes Demoniac for a number of turns (equal to the layers of Madness he has). All layers of Madness are consumed when his Demoniac state ends. ;Demoniac (鬼王降临/鬼王降臨) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Grants him immunity to all control effect and effects such as Banish. His attacks also deal 10% HP Steal. ;Madness (狂気) :'''Buff, Status''': Increases the number of follow-up attacks Calabash Spray inflicts. :''(1-4 flaming calabash will circle around him, 1 calabash represents 1 layer.)''
